crossRefs.note: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.
A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.
Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

translations.web: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.
translations.bsb: A fool vents all his anger, but a wise man holds it back.
translations.kjv: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
translations.asv: A fool uttereth all his anger; But a wise man keepeth it back and stilleth it.
